title: Setup wizard
description: Configure the essentials to get your portal ready. Progress is saved as you go — you can leave and resume anytime.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Company names and HR contact details used across the portal, letters and emails.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Logo, colors and portal name. Colors apply instantly across the portal and emails.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Your organizational units. Add the main ones now; you can build the hierarchy later.

jobTitles.title: Job titles
jobTitles.description: Positions used in employee records and certificates.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.description: Leave types aligned with the Saudi Labor Law are ready. Review entitlements and rules.

requestTypes.title: Request types
requestTypes.description: The HR requests employees can submit. Defaults are ready — adjust names, forms and SLAs.

workflows.title: Approval workflows
workflows.description: Who approves each request type and in what order.

hrAdmin.title: HR admin
hrAdmin.description: Invite at least one HR administrator to run day-to-day HR operations.

email.title: Email
email.description: Check email delivery so people receive invitations, approvals and alerts.

employeeImport.title: Employee import
employeeImport.description: Bring in your employees from Excel, or add them one by one.

org.more: Address, registration and working days are on the full Organization page.

empty.departments: No departments yet — add your first one above.
empty.jobTitles: No job titles yet — add your first one above.
empty.locations: No locations yet — add your first one above.
empty.leaveTypes: No active leave types. Open the full page to activate them.
empty.requestTypes: No active request types. Open the full page to activate them.

hints.leaveTypes: Entitlements, attachments and gender rules are editable on the Leave types page.
hints.requestTypes: Forms, approval workflows and SLAs are editable from Request configuration.

hrAdmin.noPermission: You need user administration permission to invite users.
hrAdmin.hint: The invitee receives an email to set their password. Their role can be changed later in Users.

emailStep.configure: Delivery is configured on the server with RESEND_API_KEY or SMTP settings and EMAIL_FROM (see the deployment guide).
